This is modeled as a conditional probability P(S|R=1), where S represents a source and R its rights status. Second, it employs a scalable triage model to handle large volumes of URLs by batching them into manageable chunks, effectively reducing complexity through pagination. The triage kernel is derived from statistical sampling and classification thresholds. Finally, it maintains strict separation of record types—active, licensed, reference, and candidate—ensuring no semantic ambiguity arises during processing. These primitives form a coherent mathematical structure where each layer builds upon the previous one, creating a robust pipeline for media intelligence.
